top_signals.title: Activist Investor Bergeron Says Ethan Allen CEO Needs to Go
top_signals.summary: DGB Investments founder Douglas Bergeron is pushing to make major changes at Ethan Allen Interiors Inc. The activist investor says CEO and Chairman Farooq Kathwari needs to be removed and be replaced by Stefanie Tsen Ward. Bergeron speaks on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Next phase of workers rights overhaul risks hammering ‘labour market’
top_signals.summary: The latest phase of the government’s workers rights overhaul may have “an adverse impact on the labour market”, experts have warned, as businesses deal with the costly implications of taking on new staff. top_signals.title: Florida warns that 4.9 million people had Social Security numbers leaked in financial aid site breach
top_signals.summary: The state’s Department of Education (FLDOE) said on Thursday it became aware of a data breach involving the Florida Student Financial Aid website on October 19.

top_signals.title: Brasília em Off: O que Lula entendeu das urnas
top_signals.summary: A repórter Martha Beck detalha a sua coluna Brasília em Off. Com produção de Beatriz Amat e edição de Gisele Fernandes. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Binance suspends withdrawals and freezes funds after $6.3bn hack
Binance investigating hack as suspicious outflows reach up to $5.8 billion
top_signals.summary: Tether and Circle froze $1.79 billion in USDT and USDC after billions moved out of Binance hot wallets. Binance says it is investigating.
